correctness.rationale: The exact connected 12-vertex cubic edge-list graph was independently checked isomorphic to the standard NetworkX Frucht graph, with only identity automorphism, 18 edges, three induced triangles, and its unique 4-cycle {2,3,8,9}. Rebuilding all 220 triples gives exactly 30 connected triples (27 induced P3 and 3 triangles), and the Alexander dual has faces by cardinality (1,12,66,30,1), with only the tetrahedron {2,3,8,9}. A fresh independently implemented free-face algorithm checked every strict coface and produced 30 valid elementary collapses, ending in a connected 12-vertex 37-edge graph and hence 26 circles. Exact combinatorial Alexander duality gives H~_8(Delta_3(F);Z)=Z^26 and all other reduced integer groups zero. Because no dual 5-face exists, Delta includes the complete six-skeleton of the 11-simplex, is 5-connected; successive Hurewicz vanishing in dimensions 6 and 7 makes it 7-connected. Since it is 8-dimensional, Hurewicz and homological Whitehead upgrade the integral top homology basis to the asserted wedge of 26 eight-spheres. Independent direct construction of 190 disconnected-triple facets gave cut f-vector (1,12,66,220,495,792,924,792,494,190), mod-2 augmented boundary ranks (1,11,55,165,330,462,462,330,164) and only beta8=26. These field computations corroborate but are not the integral proof. Source verifier has a nonoperative incorrect comment saying graph rank =25; the computed assertion and proof correctly say 26.

Existing general combinatorial duality and Euler formulas do not themselves certify the integral wedge homotopy without additional topology.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge originality survives as a precisely specified integral homotopy computation for the ordinary three-cut complex of the classical asymmetric cubic Frucht graph. The foundational 2023/2024 and 2024/2025 full-text papers define general cut complexes and classify other graph classes, not this graph. Four relevant published Resultary family results were read in full: they respectively require no four-cycle, no triangles, no triangles plus restricted codegree, or no triangles/four-cycles; Frucht has three triangles and one four-cycle, so none implies its 26-sphere classification. The original candidate itself appears in the published index and is not falsely counted as earlier independent priority evidence. General Alexander-duality/Euler identities may determine numerical Euler differences but not on their own the checked integral collapse and homotopy equivalence. This is a small isolated exact instance, and genuine unindexed or otherwise equivalent precedents remain possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed or inaccessible prior Frucht ordinary-three-cut calculation or graph database entry could duplicate the 26-sphere conclusion.

The general face-lattice/Euler theory makes much of the numerical calculation elementary; the independent homotopy-specific information is the finite collapse, so novelty/value are modest rather than a broad new theorem.
Other publications containing a general three-cut theorem for graphs simultaneously containing triangles and squares were not exhaustively ruled out.
The source same-model claim of prior reading is not treated as independent evidence; only fresh primary-text checks listed above support this best-of-knowledge decision.

value.rationale: The ordinary three-cut complex is an established natural graph-to-topology invariant, and the Frucht graph is a canonical smallest asymmetric cubic graph. Its coexistence of three graph triangles and one square puts it outside both established triangle-free-square and four-cycle-free-triangle classification families. A complete integral homotopy classification is stronger than a finite-field Betti count; the explicit 30-step collapse identifies why the square changes the sphere multiplicity from the out-of-domain 25 expression to 26. An exact small canonical boundary example can be useful in future graph-family classification or testing even without a universal cubic-graph theorem. The contribution is intrinsically narrow and relies on a specific finite enumeration; no broader structural or shellability claim is inferred.

final_claim: For the specified 12-vertex Frucht graph F, the ordinary three-cut complex with facets complements of disconnected induced three-vertex sets has exactly 190 eight-dimensional facets and integral homotopy type Delta_3(F) ≃ wedge^{26} S^8; the Alexander dual collapses by one tetrahedron-triangle and 29 triangle-edge free pairs onto a connected 12-vertex graph with 37 edges.
limitations: Exactly one finite labeled graph, not all cubic/Halin/asymmetric graphs.
The numeric out-of-domain 25 from a four-cycle-free theorem is illustrative only and not a valid theorem application.
Mod-two chain ranks alone cannot establish integral homotopy; the checked free-face collapse plus standard duality and connectivity are decisive.
No classification of shellability or automorphism action; Frucht graph is asymmetric.
Unindexed equivalents and historical exact Frucht tables remain possible.
Scientific C/O/V passes do not constitute a new external human attestation or publication; publication transport withheld for provenance sanitization.
